annotation.title_clean: PL n. 1522/2024 - Dispõe sobre a utilização de ferramentas tecnológicas de inteligência artificial para gestão e manutenção de dados no Sistema Único de Saúde em todo território nacional
annotation.title_en: Bill 1522/2024 - On the use of artificial intelligence tools for data management and maintenance in the Unified Health System throughout the national territory
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill tasking the Ministry of Health with planning AI tools to manage Unified Health System (SUS) data, replacing the SUS number with the CPF as the single identifier and integrating chronic and rare disease histories. The justification proposes a reverse auction for consortia of big tech and national data firms.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ministry of Health must plan AI tools for SUS data management
AI tools must link chronic and rare disease histories to the CPF
SUS number to be eliminated in favour of CPF as single identifier (Law 14.534/2023)
Plan must set a feasible, transparent, objective implementation timeline
Justification proposes reverse auction with foreign big tech in consortium with national data firms
